definitions: A group of students taught together at school, college, or university.
A lesson in which a group of students are taught together.
A system that divides people in a society into different social and economic groups.
A group of animals or plants ranking above an order and below a phylum.
A set or category of things having a common characteristic and not containing any subsets.
examples: The whole class passed the exam.
I have a history class at 10 AM.
